fixture-guide.title: Read the fixture dashboard
fixture-guide.summary: An invented guide for the episode lint self-test.

steps.title: Open the toolbar
steps.seeLine: The Settings dialog opens over the dashboard.
steps.ifNotLine: If nothing opens, close any open dialog and select Settings again.

steps.title: Send the changes
steps.doLine: Select Push Changes, then Push in the dialog.
steps.seeLine: The progress bar counts the stations as they are sent.
steps.ifNotLine: If Push is greyed out, tick at least one station.
